Obtain and attach the No Objection Certificate cum Experience Certificate from the concerned CDM & PHO / appointing authority.
Place the completed form and enclosures inside an envelope and superscribe as "Application for the post of [Name of the post] & Category of application 'In House Candidate'".
Send the application via Regd. Post/Speed Post/courier only to the O/o CDM&PHO, Subarnapur, PIN-767017.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 06.11.2026 by (05.00 P.M).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ZSS Subarnapur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Log on to https://subarnapur.odisha.gov.in for detail terms, condition & application forms. Fill out the application form with personal, educational, and NHM employment details. Enclose self-attested photocopies of all required educational certificates, identity proof, appointment order, and contract renewal proof. Obtain and attach the No Objection Certificate cum Experience Certificate from the concerned CDM & PHO / appointing authority. Place the completed form and enclosures inside an envelope and superscribe as "Application for the post of [Name of the post] & Category of application 'In House Candidate'". Send the application via Regd. Post/Speed Post/courier only to the O/o CDM&PHO, Subarnapur, PIN-767017. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 06.11.2026 by (05.00 P.M).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Set of all certificate in support of Educational Qualification Two copies of passport size colour self attested photograph Self attested photocopy of Identity proof Original Appointment order / Joining Report. Order related to transfer & joining, if any No Objection Certificate cum Experience certificate from concerned CDM & PHO / appointing authority & Proof of Contract renewal i.e renewal order / agreement copy Caste certificate (if SC, ST, or OBC is claimed, by attaching caste certificate) Experience Certificate, No objection certificate from, Proof of last contract renewal / copy of agreement from concerned appointing authority

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under ZSS Subarnapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies across 16 different posts are announced for in-house repositioning under ZSS Subarnapur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form for ZSS Subarnapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The duly filled application form in all respect should reach the O/o CDM&PHO, Subarnapur, PIN-767017, by 06.11.2026 up to (05.00 P.M) through Regd. Post/Speed Post/courier only.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Only Contractual Employee currently working under NHM in the same post of OSH&FW society in the other districts, desiring to be posted in Subarnapur District are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q4. Can fresh or outside candidates apply for ZSS Subarnapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, application received from outside candidates other than the contractual employees currently working under NHM will be rejected.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline through Regd. Post/Speed Post/courier only.

faq.question: Q6. What must be written on the envelope containing the application form?
faq.answer: The application must by superscribed as "Application for the post of [Name of the post] & Category of application 'In House Candidate'".

faq.question: Q7. Are the positions under ZSS Subarnapur permanent?
faq.answer: No, the above positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the scheme.

faq.question: Q8. Under which order will the selection and repositioning be conducted?
faq.answer: Selection will be made as per office order no 3418 dated 12.03.2018 of Mission Director, NHM, Odisha.
